notes.title: Super Arcade Football v. 1.00
notes.content:
[b]Hi SAF Friends,[/b]

We're thrilled to announce that Super Arcade Football is out of early access! It's been a long journey, and we'd like to thank all SAF fans - both old and new - for their continued support and feedback. In this update we've fixed a few bugs and polished the game's features. 

[b]Here's the brand-new trailer for SAF:[/b]

[previewyoutube=9W5izcJKqCM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]And here are the features available in SAF:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Story Mode[/b]
Follow Martin as he does everything he can to save his favourite club, Balarm F.C., from bankruptcy. You might encounter a few interesting characters along the way.

[*] [b]Modifiers[/b]
Do you want the goals to be bigger, or the pitch to be covered in mud, or meteors to fall from the sky?! (Almost) anything is possible with the vast range of modifiers included in Super Arcade Football.

[*] [b]2-Player Online Multiplayer[/b]
Play against a friend, or random opponent, over the internet.

[*] [b]4-Player Local Multiplayer[/b]
Play with up to 3 friends on your sofa at home.

[*] [b]Full Gamepad Support[/b]
Super Arcade Football supports an array of controllers - the game is best experienced on gamepad.

[*] [b]Custom Tournaments[/b]
Play the league, knockout, or mixed format tournament of your dreams.

[*] [b]Soundtrack By Barry Leitch[/b]
Renowned composer Barry Leitch (Top Gear SNES, Horizon Chase Turbo, Lotus Turbo Challenge 2) has produced a unique soundtrack specifically for Super Arcade Football!

[*] [b]Tactic Management And Substitutions[/b]
Manage your tactics to be more offensive or defensive depending on how the game's going. You can also make substitutions if one of your players gets injured or isn't performing well.
[/list]
Over the course of this week the developers will be queuing for multiplayer matches, so hop online and if you're lucky you can play against one of us! Once again we'd like to thank the players for helping us get SAF over the finish line, we hope you like the game as much as we do.

Thanks for playing!

[i]- The OutOfTheBit Team[/i]

notes.title: SAF v. 0.720 - Injuries, Modifiers, and Women
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18942219/2903bcb6322e42e33d9bd2e6546b122050be9cc9.png[/img]

[b]Dear SAF Friends,[/b]

It's been a few weeks since the last update and we've not been resting on our laurels. 
We've got a ton of new features for you to enjoy.

I'm happy to announce that we've added support for injuries. So make sure you don't get tackled too much or your players might be taken out.

We've also added the following optional modifiers:
[list]
[*] Nets (small / regular / large)
[*] Injuries (on / off)
[*] Game Speed (slow / regular / fast)
[*] Sleepy Keeper (on / off)
[*] Looser Ball (on / off)
[*] Oil (on / off)
[*] Mud (on / off)
[*] Turbo Objects (on / off)
[/list]
You can now come up with some crazy combinations! Many of those modifiers can now be found on the preset tournaments as well.

Last but not least, there is now a vast selection of women's teams available (I'm very happy with this inclusion, highly requested by my two daughters).

We've also made many changes to the gameplay, to make the game more challenging and fun.

As usual, thanks to all of you for your great feedback, it's really appreciated! Many thanks to Daniele C, SFlav, Korben Dallas and Steviebwoy, just to name a few.

Enjoy the game and see you at the next update!

[I]- Ali (OutOfTheBit Director)
[/i]

notes.title: The New Super Arcade Football
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18942219/110af408bcbc8e4dd71080a7b056f8fe57a492a8.png[/img]

[b]Hey Everyone,[/b]

We've been working hard for the past year and we're finally ready to show you the fruits of our labour. The new Super Arcade Football has been released as an update to the main game.

The game was rebuilt from scratch in our custom engine that we used for our other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1103770/Super_Arcade_Racing/]Super Arcade Racing[/url]. That means that the UI, and all code and art was completely remade from the ground up for a faster, more arcade-like experience.

We're working hard on introducing as many features as possible to the game. 

[b]Here's what we have so far:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Single Player[/b]
    Hop straight in and play a thrilling game of football against the AI. A smart computer combined with simple controls that are easy to learn and hard to master makes an exciting experience for players of all skills.

[*] [b]Online And Local Multiplayer[/b]
     Play with friends on your sofa at home or over the internet. Up to 4 players at once supported, with full gamepad support.

[*] [b]A Full Stadium[/b]
     A stadium packed with an adoring crowd, TV cameras and even a few marshals in case things get a little too heated.
[/list]
[b]And here's what we're working on right now:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Modifiers[/b]
     Shake up the game by having meteors fall from the sky at random moments, or maybe make it so there is no out of bounds, or have the ref take the day off. We've included the meteor modifier in the game already as a teaser (this will become optional in the future).

[*] [b]Tournaments[/b]
     Become champions of the World or Europe, or play in your own custom tournaments.

[*] [b]Many More Features[/b]
    Go to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/420550/Super_Arcade_Football/]store page[/url] to check out the roadmap and watch this space for more updates and improvements to the game as we near release.
[/list]

[b]Here's a short trailer highlighting the game:[/b]

[previewyoutube=zgbRghndKPU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]And here's a video of a full match played in the current game:[/b]

[previewyoutube=Dj3-v2msG20;full]GAMEPLAY VIDEO[/previewyoutube]

We hope you like the new SAF, leave any feedback in the comments and we'll be sure to listen and take it into account.

For anyone wanting to play the old version of Super Arcade Football, it's now been moved to the legacy branch on steam. Go to [i]properties -> betas[/i] in the game in your library to download that version. The current version of the game no longer supports macOS but we will reintroduce this in an update in the future.

Thanks for playing!

[i]- The OutOftheBit Team[/i]

notes.title: SAF Development Update!
notes.content:
[h1]A plethora of bug fixes![/h1]

Hello everyone! We have been focusing on working through our bugs/general improvements list and are happy to give you this update which includes quite a few of them!

Here's what's new:
[list]

[*][h1][b]Added time of day settings to match setup menu[/b] [/h1]
It's random by default, but if you feel like playing at the crack of dawn, now you can choose as you wish!

[*][h1][b]Bug fixes and general improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased ball speed / kick powers
[*] Reviewed energy reduction and restoration
[*] Fixed Keeper circling around the ball
[*] Shadows all face the same way
[*] Fixed meteorite on replay / online
[*] Fixed power up collection
[*] Fixed [i]SAF Cam[/i] online
[*] Reviewed the statistics recording (specifically shots)
[*] Moved players closer to center circle on Kick Off
[*] Fixed the issues with players running onto pitch from tunnel
[*] Referee now gives fouls for slide tackles from behind
[*] Keeper now takes the goal kick from nearest side
[*] Fixed crash on 5-a-side throw-ins/corners/goal kicks
[*] Other various tweaks and fixes ːsteammockingː

[/list]


[/list]

A big thanks as always to those of you who have pointed out issues and put forward your suggestions on how to improve SAF. 

We know there are still some issues remaining, and we are working towards fixing all those pesky bugs and improving the game until it's at a level we can all be happy with.

Thanks for reading!!

notes.content:

Hello! Another update, here's what's new:

[list]

notes.title: SAF Development Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]I HAVE THE POWERRRRRR![/b][/h1]

Oi oiiiii! We're here again with a nice update! 

Here's what's new:
[list]
    [*][h1] [b]POWER UPS!![/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pT4rbLr.gif[/img]
Say hello to your new favorite modifier; [b][i]Power Ups![/i][/b]
These are special items that spawn on the pitch which you can pick up by walking into or kicking the ball at. The current available power ups are:

[list]
    [*] [b]Boost![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GpFPWFe.png[/img]
Gain great speeds for a short amount of time.

    [*] [b]Oil Slick![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/N2JrNMl.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DIlFtCp.png[/img]

    [*] [b]Slow down[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IgaBBX9.png[/img]

Online should be a lot smoother now as we have done a bit of optimising on the way we send / receive the data.

[/list]

That's about it for this release, we really hope you like it. Next we're going to focus on the more football-y side of the game. Did someone say diving headers??

notes.title: SAF Development Update! Beta Patch
notes.content:
[h1] We’re moving the goal posts[/h1]
Hello!
We have a new version of SAF to test on the [i]beta branch[/i]! We’d like to get more feedback on this version before we move it over to the default branch, so please do let us know your thoughts!

Here's what's new:
[list]
    [*][h1][b]Bigger pitch![/b] [/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3lljgpW.gifi[/img]
We’ve completely resized the football pitch! It’s much bigger now meaning you have more space to link passes and build actions. This also helps freekick states be more playable.

    [*][h1][b]Reviewed ball control![/b] [/h1]
With bigger pitches comes bigger kicks! The way you kick the ball is a bit more mature and finessed, with more control over passes, strikes and crosses. We have also added a power bar to give you a visual feedback on your strengths. It may get a bit of time to get used to, but we think it gives more control to the player.

    [*][h1][b]Added a mini map![/b] [/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xtOmwNV.gif[/img]
Now with a bigger pitch you may want to know where exactly all your players are, so now by pushing the [i]TAB[/i] key you can toggle on/off the mini map (We will be adding this into the settings menu at some point!)

    [*][h1][b]Tactic improvements[/b] [/h1]
Teammates should help you out a bit more when you have the ball. This is an ongoing improvement.

    [*][h1][b]Camera Tweaks[/b] [/h1]
Camera should be a bit more helpful in crossing scenarios

    [*][h1][b]Bug fixes[/b] [/h1]
UI and gameplay fixes, many many more to be fixed
[/list]

[b]**PLEASE NOTE:**[/b]
This version is only available on the beta saf_beta_work_in_progress branch (we’ll leave details at the end of this announcement).
With the reviewed pitch sizes, we now need to redesign our stadium, so unfortunately this version of the stadium is a bit out of proportion, but we will fix this when we update on the main branch.

Phew, what a lot of text. Again, please please PLEASE let us know what you think of these changes, we know it’s quite a big change gameplay wise but we are having much more fun with this layout than the previous versions, and hope you guys enjoy it too.

Thanks for reading!!


Here's how to activate the beta branch if you don't know yet:
[list]
    [*]Go to the [i]library page[/i] on steam
    [*]In the games column on the left, right click Super Arcade Football
    [*]Click [i]Properties[/i]
    [*]Select the [i]Betas[/i] tab
    [*]On the drop down list, select [i]saf_beta_work_in_progress[/i]
    [*]That's it!
[/list]

notes.title: SAF Development Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Our final update for this year![/b][/h1]

We're here again and ignoring all logical and intelligent suggestions to not deploy an update before the Christmas holidays....what could go wrong!?

**PLEASE NOTE**
If you have edited teams in our in game editor, unfortunately you will lose your changes, such is the life of early access :(. If you've made lots of changes and don't want to see them gone let us know and we may be able to convert them and give you a new file (your edited teams file will not be deleted but just ignored on startup). If you are loading custom data from a .csv this update shouldn't affect you.

Here's what's new:
[list]
    [*][h1][b]Ongoing Tournaments[/b] [/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RIZvCbA.png[/img]
You can now have multiple saves of multiple tournaments, so if you have some friends round and want to save your progress, now you can. If you want to start a new one you can rest easy knowing that the previous won't be overwritten!

    [*][h1][b]Many bug fixes[/b][/h1]
Specifically in team data (all changes made in the edit team menus should be consistent throughout the game), tournaments, UI and collisions. We also gave the gk a shirt number on his back! Thanks to those who spotted this and let us know!

[/list]

We've had a fairly good year, and some good progress made, but in the last couple of months we have really found our stride and seem to be improving the game a lot quicker, so let's keep up the pace! We couldn't and wouldn't have done it without all of your support, so from all of us at OutOfTheBit, thanks very much and Happy Holidays! We will see you next year ːsteamhappyː

[/list]

That's about it for this weeks release, hope you like it.

[b][h1]More fixes and improvements...GET IN![/h1][/b]

We're back again with another update this week, with a few more improvements and bug fixes.

Here's what's new:
[list]
    [*][b]Improved Referee ending the match[/b]
The referee is now not so eager to blow the half time / final whistle, he'll allow the play to continue if a team is in an advantageous state. So now he won't call time just before the ball hits the back of the net! Thanks to user [i]BlackRebel[/i] for pointing this out!
 
[*][b]Reviewed the kick off handling[/b]
Kick offs are improved for co-op matches. We've also reduced the kick off spot. 

[*][b]Celebrate with the lads!  [/b]
If you are playing local co-op, every human player can celebrate a goal!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sinpbWL.gif[/img]

[*][b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
Tackles will now leave players on the floor for a certain amount of time, and render them unusable for that duration. You'll notice this improvement more if you're use to playing local multiplayer.

[*][b]Bug fixes[/b]
Quite a few bug fixes in this release, especially in team management / substitution scenarios.
[/list]

We have now begun work on more visual improvements and added content...[i]the fun part![/i] More features generally means more dev time and ultimately more bugs to iron out, but we are aiming to keep up this pace of regular updates.

Hope you enjoy these fixes.

Come swing by our Discord channel sometime, if you fancy a game online, have any issues or just want to say hello feel free to stop in!

notes.title: SAF Development Update! Beta Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello! Long time no speak. [/h1]

We're very happy to say that there is a new [i]beta[/i] branch available for anyone to test! It will be updated FAR more regularly with fixes and changes.

Here's how to:

[list]
    [*]Go to the library page on steam
    [*]In the games column on the left, right click Super Arcade Football
    [*]Click Properties
    [*]Select the [i]Betas[/i] tab
    [*]On the drop down list, select [i]saf_beta_work_in_progress[/i]
    [*]That's it!
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VlIZTVf.gif[/img]

At the moment, it's purely just new basic game play and new UI. We have locked out all features other than quick match as they are still under construction; but rather than keeping you waiting with no updates, we wanted to at least give something new for you to play, and give feedback on.

Hopefully you will see an improvement from the current version. We've taken a lot into consideration, slowed things down a bit, made crosses and headers easier and changed the movement too, as well as quite a few other bits and bobs. It's still not 100% there, things need to be neatened up and reviewed, but we think it's in a good enough state for people to get their hands on and give a go.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18942219/b0678edb2c9fc1e32dcfabe38931aa3f6416bae8.gif[/img] 
[i]You can also abuse the ref by tackling him or smashing the ball at him, time for revenge![/i]


The AI has had a rewrite too, and in this first pass it seems to be quite a beast ([i]I'm not ashamed to admit that my Arsenal lost 7-1 to Jamaica[/i]).

We have rewritten a large chunk of the game play, and restructured a large majority of our code, hence why things have appeared to be not developing that fast. But behind the scenes, things are much easier for us to maintain and add to.

Everything is still up for review, and we will be making many more changes in the following weeks.

[h1]So what's next?[/h1]

We are working towards the next major update which will have all the tournaments, online matchmaking and custom games added back, as well as more modifiers, teams and tournaments. Until we get there, we will be continuously updating this beta branch. And once everyone's happy with it, we will switch it over to the main default game and continue on adding more content, more game modes, and the big momma: Career.

People have been mentioning beating other games to market, console releases and what not, but we feel we haven't truly taken advantage of Early Access yet (even though we've been here for bloody ages), we want to make the game great first, then the rest shall follow.

[h1]We also have setup a discord![/h1]

Here's the server link
[i]https://discord.gg/NqAeC2y[/i]

We'll be on here 5 days a week (Mon - Fri) if you want to ask us any questions, or use it as a place to organise online matches, talk rubbish about football, or share spicy memes. All are welcome.

Thanks for your ongoing patience, we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: SAF Update #10!! - SAF Version 0.10
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sYVwJgm.gif[/img]
[i][h1]♫ Premier League!? You're 'avin a laugh♫![/h1][/i]

The Football season is back, and so are we! We've got a nice update to bring you:

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Added Premier League and Serie A Teams![/h1]
The first of many new teams have been added, with roughly up to date squads and kits (we will update according with the transfers).
[*][h1]New Tournaments!![/h1]
Along with the teams, you can relive last seasons magic of Leicester winning the PL, or take Palermo to their rightful place of top of Serie A!
At the moment there is still no load and save, but that will be added within the following weeks, so you can actually have a bit of a single player experience outside of one marathon sitting.
[*][h1]Improved online handling[/h1]
We've only gone and written our own server for SAF! This means that we now have full control of the online handling, so if for some reason the servers drop, we can fix it much quicker than if we were with a third party. We've also optimised for LAN games, so if you are playing at work or school, it should feel super smooth.
[*][h1]General bug fixes![/h1]
More to go
[/list]

Whilst we have your attention, we think now is a good time to present our plan for Super Arcade Football, and what we think needs to be added before it's out of Early Access. It's a high level plan, with no specific dates, but we just want to give you an idea of what we are working on, and also to get your feedback!


[b]The Plan (in order):[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Add Team management![/h1]
Now we have our team data system all working (and the data to go with it) we will be adding in substitutions, formations, team picking etc. This will also include gameplay changes such as energy, injuries, and red/yellow cards carrying over from matches in tournaments.

[*][h1]Create your own team![/h1]
Not to be mistaken for Career Mode (we'll get to that later). This will allow you to create and customise your own team(s), and use them online. 

[*][h1]Big Round of Gameplay Improvements![/h1]
Improving AI, Goal keepers, Referee, better physics...basically the game. As well as adding in all that good stuff we've been talking about for ages, like way more modifiers, weather, celebrations and more.

[*][h1]Super Polish and Visuals Overhaul phase![/h1]
Create new and varied player models (with more detail). Upgrading the Menus and animations so they are more polished, as well as more sounds (anyone else fed up [i]"AFC WIMBLEDON....AFC WIMBLEDON"[/i]?). Basically bringing the game to the next level in terms of quality.

[*][h1]Career Mode![/h1]
The big momma. This will take a lot of testing and work, so we think it's best to move it nearer the end of the project, so that we can focus on it completely. We have a good idea of what we  plan to include, which we will present to you lot nearer the time. This phase will also focus on the online progressions aspect of the game.

[*][h1]Final Polish![/h1]
Fix all the bugs that career mode will bring, and get the game to a gold standard.
[/list]

So, there it is. 

Now that we've built the structure for online and the data, we can really move full steam ahead on SAF. So, big thanks to everyone who's been giving great feedback, positive and negative, we are super pumped to get this game to the level everyone wants! And thanks for spreading the word, it really helps to increase the community, and to find some newbs online!

Wow that's a long announcement.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oD3YKlPdXUT3wpqZW/giphy.gif[/img]
[*][h1]Randomised teams in preset tournaments![/h1]
Thanks to your suggestions, you will have different teams in your groups when you play the World Cup and the Euros.

[*][h1]Added Morocco![/h1]
Because, we love Morocco.

[*][h1]Improved Frame Rate![/h1]
Those of you with beastly PCs may not notice this, but those on the lower end should see a massive improvement.

[*][h1]Bug Fixes![/h1]
Lots of bug fixes in this one (mainly UI)

We're working on lots of things behind the scenes, and working towards more features and content, can't wait to share those with you soon, and release them in the game!

notes.title: SAF Update #2!! - SAF Version 0.03
notes.content:
We've just updated a new version of SAF for you all to enjoy. It's a lot more balanced we thinks, you can really struggle as Tahiti vs Germany. 

[b][h1] What's new?[/h1][/b]
[list]
    [*]Skip Replay (If you scored the goal or if it's an AI Goal)
    [*]Fixed kick off bug
    [*]Tweaked Player Physics
    [*]Fixed wrong corners / Throw ins
    [*]Auto resize resolutions
    [*]Much better difference between teams/players
    [*]Icey Mode improved
    [*]AI Teams now try and defend / tackle!
    [*]Removed dead times (when waiting for players to get the ball)
    [*]General Bug Fixes
[/list]

Please let us know your thoughts on these changes. Big thank you to the guys who spotted the wrong corner bugs and also the resolution bugs, would have been hard to spot them!

We're working hard and fast on the next update  (we're trying to get one out once a week, and currently seem to be on track). The next update we hope to include the much desired [i]Settings Menu[/i], Load and Save and a more logical referee!

[h1]Eurogamer REZZED[/h1]
In other news, we had an absolute blast at[url=https://www.egx.net/rezzed] EGX Rezzed!	[/url]  Not sure how many people played SAF (definitely over 1,000!), but they all seemed to really enjoy themselves, and many of them came back for more quick matches; (we even lost a few times to some absolute beasts).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jk44mXG.jpg [/img]

Watching such a wide range of people play the game was really beneficial for us, we noticed lots of common things that we can work on to make the game even better (good and bad), and we received some more great feedback and ideas for the game.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/pvRup29.jpg[/img]

[h1]DEMO[/h1]
In even more other news...
We have made a demo for Super Arcade Football. It's downloadable through  [url=https://outofthebit.itch.io/super-arcade-football]itchio [/url] and from here on steam soon (takes a few days for it to appear). So if you know anyone on the fence about getting SAF, point them to the demo. It's limited in terms of features, team's,game types and number of matches, but we hope can provide a good demonstration of the game.

That's enough writing for now, I'll post up a discussion about this update for you to leave your thoughts :)
